name: Three Tools Roundup
description: A fast three-pick roundup: one useful tool or feature per beat, with its number and takeaway placed over the shot. Built for educational product and AI content.

picks.description: Three tools, features, or use cases to rank, as a list.

why.description: The shared outcome that makes the three picks useful.

cta.description: A simple final call to action.

nodes.system: You write tight educational short-form video. Give each of three picks one concrete benefit. On-screen text is a hook or label, not a transcript.

nodes.prompt:
{{shot.frame_prompt}}
Vertical 9:16, real desk or app screen, natural light, no visible lettering or rendered text.
nodes.negative_prompt: watermark, text overlay, subtitles, garbled UI, stock-photo polish

nodes.prompt: {{beat.shot.motion_prompt}} Continuous 5-second vertical phone footage. No speech and no generated words on screen.
nodes.negative_prompt: watermark, text overlay, subtitles, garbled interface text
